query: SELECT (EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM read_marks WHERE reader_actor=?) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM project_watches WHERE reader_actor=? AND scope_kind='project' AND scope_id=?) AS "initialized!: bool"
